title: Boat crew
commitment: One week in four on the pager, plus Tuesday training
training: About 12 months to pass out as crew
needs: Live or work within six minutes of the station|Comfortable in the water|A medical check
summary: Launch on callouts in the inshore lifeboats. Most of our crew had never been on a rescue boat before they joined.
body:
Launch on callouts in the inshore lifeboats. Most of our crew had never been on a rescue boat before they joined.

Start by coming to an open evening at the station on the first Tuesday of the month, 7:00 pm. There is no form: you meet the crew, see the boats and talk to the volunteer coordinator.

title: Shore crew
commitment: One week in four, plus monthly training
needs: Live within ten minutes of the station|A driving license for the tractor or Rescue 3
summary: Launch and recover the boats, drive the response vehicle, run the radio and search the banks.
